title: project.migrate request
description: Convert a legacy `amiga-re.toml` into project documents. `prepared_output`: `prepare` reports the plan and writes nothing, `commit_reviewed` re-derives it and writes. The config is named as a source, never a host path — it is a legacy document being converted, which is what separates this from `config show`, whose subject is the same file as this frontend's settings.

name.description: The name the imported project takes.

image.description: The image the legacy `[base]` describes. Both halves or neither: an id with no media names an object that does not exist, so the importer is told nothing rather than half a decision.

in_place.description: Write into a directory this toolkit does not own, leaving everything else there alone. An import beside the config it came from lands in a repository, where staging a replacement of the whole directory would ask a user to authorize replacing all their work.
